_comment: Template for ~/.claude/settings.json — the USER scope, which cannot be committed
because it lives outside the repository. Claude Code honours a few keys only at
user scope, so they cannot go in .claude/settings.json no matter how much we would
like them to travel with the code.
The cloud sandbox wipes ~/.claude with every container, so those keys would be lost
each session. .claude/hooks/seed-user-settings.sh installs this file on SessionStart
when ~/.claude/settings.json is absent, which is what makes the setting survive a
throwaway container. __PROJECT_DIR__ is substituted with the repository root at seed
time; an absolute path is required because the status line runs outside a project
The seeder never overwrites an existing file, so anything you set by hand wins.
Edit that file directly for personal preferences; edit this one for what every
